title: Science Rigor Wave 010 — Abstracts, Equation Context, Completion and Value Filtering
purpose: Route the 2026-09-11 corpus-wide upgrade that moved high-value science records from equation/motif collections toward research-paper logic: abstracts, typed variables, assumptions, equation context, stability, identifiability, observables, baselines, falsification and completion paths.
central_rule: Seriousness comes from constraints and discriminating tests, not from equation count or vocabulary density.

updated_records.upgrade: Abstract contract; equation annotation contract; well-posedness, identifiability, limiting-case and model-selection tests; Q completeness vector; T0-T5 maturity ladder.
UPT reframed as an EFT programme with field-content forks, fractional-operator requirements, dimensional audit, consistency tests, observable sectors and failure conditions.

4D↔5D Door separated into order parameter, spectral/effective dimension and genuine compact dimension; added dimensionless trigger, bifurcation model, scalarization comparator and strong-gravity tests.
11D programme reframed as projection/reconstruction inverse problem plus explicit compactification contract, fibers, topology, reconstruction loss and information constraints.
General framework sharpened into typed hybrid/open-system dynamics with observability, controllability, identifiability, hysteresis, viability, stability and model reduction.
Human Map converted from mixed numerical scorecards into hierarchical latent-state neuroscience/statistics programme with confounds, validation and operationalization.
Quantum Tuber/Higgs branch made into explicit real-singlet versus U(1)_P BSM model forks with vacuum, mass matrix, kinetic mixing, observables and calculation sequence.
Spudlight/Starchforce separated into optical, storage/release, information/channel and social-attention branches with units, budgets, identifiability and failure conditions.
Added molecular→polymer→cell→circuit→behavior causal ladder, classical baseline, explicit quantum-necessity contract and experimental ladder.
Cosmic Potato converted into preregistered 3D morphology/model-selection problem with descriptors, selection effects, simulation nulls and cross-scale universality contract.
Infinite/Cosmic Soil separated into Lambda-CDM baseline and explicit scalar/interacting/unified-dark-sector descendant classes with perturbation observables and failure conditions.
Door/Handshake made into a calibrated temporal-network/hybrid contagion model with homophily-vs-influence identification, stochastic hazard option and baseline comparison.
GUT/SUSY branch now requires one model route, representations, symmetry-breaking fields, normalized RG running, threshold spectrum, SUSY breaking and quantitative observables.

high_value_next_targets: End-to-end UPT/Higgs calculation from a chosen action to one observable constraint.
One solved Dimensional-Door bifurcation/scalarization model compared with GR and conventional modified gravity.
One empirical golden-ratio spiral fit against alternative geometry models.
One real-data Potato Dynamics or Door/Handshake temporal-network application.
One public-dataset Human Map latent-state study with held-out validation.
One explicit Cosmic Soil descendant fit to expansion plus growth/lensing data.
deliberate_non_upgrades: Do not turn Trinity/YHWH operator symbolism into particle physics without an independently motivated physical model.
Do not create a Starchforce fifth-force Lagrangian without an anomalous measurable force law.
Do not backsolve the unresolved 115,000-mile torus geometry.
Do not infer celestial alignments until the historical pointing vector/epoch is recovered.
Do not add more GUT/string/M-theory group names unless a representation/breaking calculation requires them.
Do not promote historical fermentation chemistry into a new theory merely because it fits the Starchforce metaphor.
relationship_to_wave_009: Wave 009 added new dated deductions. Wave 010 asks whether the major science theories themselves are formulated seriously enough to support derivation, inference, comparison and rejection.
